Thanks for the ping, Mateo. I reviewed Blue River's redline and annotated the main items. High-level:

1) Section 9 — Liability & Indemnity: Blue River's proposed language moves to a per-Order cap equal to the value of the applicable PO and removes language preserving a platform-wide aggregate cap. That is a non-starter for us operationally — we need an aggregate liability cap across all Orders to avoid open-ended exposure from repeated low-value POs.

Proposed counter: Accept a per-Order carve where the per-Order cap cannot exceed the aggregate cap (example wording included in the attached updated redline).

2) Order Form / PO mapping: Ops note — our Coupa connector maps PO.paymentTerms -> order_form.paymentTerms and includes a PO.reference field that we populate with the signed OrderForm.id when the customer provides it at enrollment. However, there are edge-cases: if a customer uses a non-standard PO schema or overrides payment terms in the portal metadata, reconciliation may require manual reconciliation. Vanessa and Kim, we should document the supported field set and fallbacks for Blue River's payables team.

3) Timeline: We can aim for Coupa activation by 10/25 but need the signed Order Form and the list of payables contacts by 10/21 to avoid last-minute data clean-up.

I've attached an updated redline with our proposed counterlanguage: MSA_Redline_BlueRiver_20261018.docx (v2). Please review, Vanessa/Kim, and confirm whether the mapping description above matches ops reality so I can send a clean counter to Jenna.

Marissa Cole

Quick ops update for the thread and recommended next steps.

- Coupa mapping: confirmed. The connector maps these fields: supplierName, poNumber, paymentTerms, netDueDate, currency, and poReference. We will populate poReference with OrderForm.id when the Order Form is uploaded to the portal during enrollment. If Blue River wants net-60, it will be preserved in paymentTerms and surface in our billing pipeline.
- Edge-case: If a PO is created via a third-party punchout or bypasses the enrollment flow, paymentTerms can default to our standard contract fallback (net-30) unless the OrderForm.id is present on the PO. We need payables to include OrderForm.id to guarantee mapping.
- Activation readiness: Ops can complete Coupa activation by 10/24 EOD if we have: signed Order Form, final redline acceptance on liability language (or acknowledgment of our counter), and the primary payables contact.
